item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies turn mostly cloudy across the region with low temperatures dropping between twenty-six and thirty-one degrees and only a slight chance of precipitation. Thursday brings overcast to mostly cloudy skies with widespread rain and snow developing, and high temperatures ranging from forty-one to forty-four degrees. Rain and snow continue Thursday night with lows from twenty-six to thirty-one degrees, and some areas could see up to two inches of new snow accumulation.
